pools: Primary exact timestamp-aligned raw quotes; separate secondary mixed recorded-price pool adding historical FT rows. Secondary legacy quotes have unknown quote timestamps and cannot validate exact-provider execution.
source: Every saved manual, primary, experimental and live-lab snapshot plus original historical FT records; every valid original exact over quote is extracted before rule search.
unit: One first qualifying priced point per event and rule; all observations of an event stay in one temporal cohort. Unquoted observations receive no invented ROI.
purge: Remove events spanning a discovery/validation/test boundary. Discovery and validation labels must have been confirmed before the subsequent cohort began.
features: Clock, score, line, price, overround, cumulative measured stats, validated complete fresh windows and original goal-profile fields; missing is unknown, never zero.
cut_learning: Discovery-only first priced observation per match, not repeated-point quantiles. No threshold is fitted on validation or test results.
search: All one- and two-feature conjunctions of the learned numeric cuts and observed categorical levels; no old pocket conditions or names are supplied.
shortlist_rank: Discovery-only one-sided iid lower mean bound, with positive raw and leave-best-day and leave-best-league returns; at least three discovery days. This is screening, not a statistical claim.
test: Evaluate every frozen shortlisted rule; Holm correction across that whole list. Never substitute a different rule after seeing test results.
research_survivor: Positive validation and test ROI and leave-top3/day/league ROI, adequate phase support and positive full mature ROI; statistical status is disclosed separately.
walk_forward: For each next day learn cuts and rank rules using only earlier original points and labels confirmed before that day; take the first three discovery-ranked rules, deduplicate matches, and retain every losing or empty day. This is a separate predeclared research-policy simulation.
confirmation_limit: All history has previously been inspected in some form. These temporal tests are reconstructed out-of-time checks, not a newly untouched confirmatory holdout. Execution at the provider price is not established.
expanded_screen_note: Every original discovery-screen survivor is evaluated on later dates,without an arbitrary20-rule cap. The expanding historical audit is exploratory; no already-viewed historical test is called untouched. Holm includes both full candidate families.
profile_integrity: Read original nested league/home/away sample means and N; neutral ranking ratios with ranking_used=false remain unknown. This corrects field extraction, not outcome-fitted thresholds.
